name: Yukisora Conflict
original_name: ユキソラ・コンフリクト
source:
On a snowy Christmas night, Makoto suddenly comes to Yuki's house.
Makoto reveals his feelings for Yuki, which Yuki is unable to accept.

A year later, Yuki tries to answer his confession that Christmas night, but Makoto refuses and ......!
